titulo.alumno: Intermediate · Services and returns: Contextual reading

intro: T2 · Elementary · Understand the meaning and details of everyday written exchanges; understand notices, timetables and simple descriptive texts. Topic: Services and returns. Focus: Reading comprehension.

texto: Contextual reading of an exchange at a shop: read the conversation between a customer who bought a faulty appliance and the after-sales service assistant. Notice the polite argument and the checking of the warranty conditions.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การตรวจสอบสภาพบรรจุภัณฑ์ก่อนเซ็นรับพัสดุช่วยรักษาสิทธิของผู้บริโภค» express?

opciones.texto: Checking the package before signing for delivery protects the buyer's rights.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การตรวจสอบสภาพบรรจุภัณฑ์ก่อนเซ็นรับพัสดุช่วยรักษาสิทธิของผู้บริโภค» from the text.

opciones.texto: Contacting after-sales service resolves technical questions about use.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Customer satisfaction is the central goal for raising service quality.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: According to the interaction you read, why does the customer ask to exchange the item?

opciones.texto: Because the product is faulty or damaged (สินค้านี้เสีย)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: the customer explicitly states «สินค้านี้เสีย».

opciones.texto: Because they chose the wrong colour when buying it
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: the problem is that the item is faulty.

opciones.texto: Because they found a cheaper price online
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: no price comparison is mentioned.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.

opciones.texto: If you're not satisfied, you can return the product.
opciones.explicacion: The translation matches the Thai sentence.

opciones.texto: This product is faulty. Can I exchange it?
opciones.explicacion: This is another sentence on the same topic.

opciones.texto: The receipt as well, please. (common polite phrase with ค่ะ)
opciones.explicacion: This sentence expresses a different idea on the same topic.

pregunta.texto: Complete the Thai sentence that expresses «If you're not satisfied, you can return the product.».
